Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Automatically opens a compact animation-suggestion window when another lobby member selects a mod, showing detected roles, all options, and Notes. Recipients can dismiss locally or decline and notify the suggesting actor.
